steps.caption: Signal → action: a new signal matches the company, finds decision-makers, rescores, maybe prepares one draft.
Lease → renewal / relocation: a lease near expiry gets a proposed requirement, options and a task.
Reply → meeting: a reply asking to meet links the meeting (no time is guessed) and pauses follow-ups.
Job change → re-engagement: a contact moves company; history is kept and the new employer rescored.
Visit feedback → comparison: site-visit feedback re-runs the saved building comparison.
Meeting completed → follow-ups: rescore and show the tasks and draft it created.
Each shows On or Off. 'Turn off' stops that chain; 'Turn on' restarts it.
Check now runs all chains immediately instead of waiting.

Each step is listed with what it did and why.
Material steps (like a new requirement) stop and wait for you. 'Approval' opens it.
